court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
case_number: W.P. No. 13449 of 2026 and W.M.P. Nos. 14663 and 14665 of 2026
advocates: For Respondent(s) : Mr. K. Karthik Jagannath Government Advocate for R 3 to R 6, R 8 to R 10
Mr. M. Nandha Kumar for R 12
judgment_text:
PRAYER : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the respondents 1 to 10 to stop the illegal functioning of the 12th respondent school from the upcoming academic year 2026-2027 and also forbid any sort of educational activities including new admission, training, tutorial, etc. without any valid recognition or approval thereby endangering the life, safety, education and future of all student children.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to approach the competent authority in accordance with law.

2. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
